gre_descriptive_norm.definition: What the people around you actually do, whether or not it is written down.
gre_descriptive_norm.example: The descriptive norm here is that the whole team stays for the handover, and the expectation follows the team.

intel_working_memory.definition: The small amount of information a person can hold in mind for a short time and still use.
intel_working_memory.example: His working memory filled up with the five readings he was tracking, and he lost the first one.

orbit.definition: The path one space object follows as it goes around and around another one.
orbit.example: The Moon is in orbit around the Earth.

starter.definition: The small first course, such as soup, a salad or fried snacks.
starter.example: As a starter, I will have the soup.
